pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Fianchetto Defense Deferred
pages.notes: Plan 3 named Bg7 as a White move; overview claimed 3...a6 sidesteps the Fianchetto lines. Rewrote overview around the ...b5 option and the c3/d4 or d4 replies; plans now give ...d6, ...Nge7 and the ...f5 break. Reviewer rejected a pin claim (d7-pawn still there); fixed and re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Norwegian Variation, Nightingale Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 suggested ...Kg8 (impossible: king on e8, then g8-knight in the way after 7.Nxe5+). Overview now explains 6...Kxf7 7.Nxe5+ and two pawns for the piece; plans rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 4.Ba4
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Nd2-f1-g3 with no knight on d2; now Nbd2-f1-g3 after castling and Re1. Plan 2 said ...b5 breaks a pin that does not exist; rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Schliemann Deferred, 5.d4 exd4 6.e5
pages.notes: Plan 4 had an ambiguous ...Ne7; plan 2 claimed an open f-file (Black f5-pawn still there). Plans rewritten around regaining d4, ...d6 and ...Bc5/...Nge7-g6.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Modern Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...exd4 with no pawn on d4; rewritten with the Siesta. Plan 2 now notes the real pin on c6. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, 5.d4
pages.notes: Overview generic; rewritten around the pin and the Noah's Ark Trap (5...b5 6.Bb3 Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4 8.Qxd4? c5). Plan 2 had a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Modern Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1 and the d2-pawn in place; now after c3, Re1 and d4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, 5.O-O Bd7
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 said Black still has to break the pin, which 5...Bd7 already did; plan 3 had Nf1-g3 with the rook on f1. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, 5.O-O Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed ...Be7 with a knight on e7 and a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight; overview also cited ...c5. Rewritten around ...Ng6, ...Bd7, ...Be7. Reviewer rejected a ...g6 fianchetto with the knight on g6; removed and re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Richter Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed ...Bd7-e8-g6 through the king on e8; plan 1 said a c4-knight controls c5. Plans 1, 2 and 4 rewritten (d4 and the doubled c-pawns; ...d5 break; ...Rb8 on the half-open b-file). British spelling.
